# Vendored code

`codemirror.min.js` is CodeMirror 5.65 (MIT license, see LICENSE): `lib/codemirror.js`, `mode/clike/clike.js`,
`addon/edit/matchbrackets.js` and `addon/edit/closebrackets.js`, joined and minified with terser.
`codemirror.css` is its stylesheet. They are the code editor inside simulator steps.
